elements.description:
A run's reproducibility record: model, settings, instruction hash, sources, intent and the verification summary,
with copy and export.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: runId
properties.description: The run's id – shown under the heading, with a copy button

properties.name: timestamp
properties.description: When the run happened, shown as given – e.g. "Oct 24, 14:02 UTC"

properties.name: model
properties.description: The model's display name, shown as a badge in the head

properties.name: modelId
properties.description: The model's exact id or version – what reproducing the run needs; shown in full with a copy button

properties.name: modelIcon
properties.description: An icon for the model badge, cloned in (an svg or img)

properties.name: settings
properties.description: Sampling and other settings, in order: temperature, top-p, maximum tokens, seed…

properties.name: instructionLabel
properties.description: The instruction's name or version, e.g. "Analyst v4"

properties.name: instructionHash
properties.description: The instruction's hash – shown shortened, copied in full

properties.name: sources
properties.description: The sources and corpus the run drew on

properties.name: sourceLimit
properties.description: How many sources show before "Show all"

properties.name: intent
properties.description: The intent the session was started with, in the person's words

properties.name: verification
properties.description: Claims per verification state: verified, unverifiable, incorrect, dismissed, pending

properties.name: noun
properties.description: What the verified things are called, plural – "claims"

properties.name: manifest
properties.description: The whole record as data – what Copy writes as JSON and Export hands to the app

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: A copy button was pressed (detail: { field: "run" | "model" | "instruction" | "manifest", text: string }); cancelable – prevent it to write the clipboard yourself

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

props.name: modelIcon
props.description: An icon for the model badge – an Element, cloned in

props.name: onCopy
props.description: A copy button was pressed: which field and the text copied. Return false to copy it yourself instead

props.name: onExport
props.description: Export was pressed, with the whole record
